$comment: Repositories the API reference is generated from. 'ref' is a branch, tag or commit. Override per run with SF_<KEY>_REF (branch/tag/sha) or SF_<KEY>_DIR (use a local checkout, no fetch); keys are CS, CS_UTILITIES and TS. The same overrides are exposed as --cs-ref, --utilities-ref and --ts-ref on `npm run local` and as workflow_dispatch inputs on the Test deployment workflow.

csharpUtilities.$comment: Dependency of the C# framework. Compiled alongside it so its types resolve; excluded from the generated pages.
